scope: Source-observed current implementation, not a claim that all features/states are tested, polished or accepted at 60 FPS. Advanced standalone review scenes are distinguished below.

main_game.feature: Empty-field rear opening and connected battlefield observation, persistent session, Pause/1x/2x, navigation and new session confirmation.
Eleven buildable facility types, rotation, position/overlap validation, provisional preview, physical construction materials/work, preview/site cancellation and preservation of consumed material.
Purchase and arrival of actual workers; staffing targets, priorities, travel/reporting and actual work assignments.
Requisition purchases, recipe/blueprint access, physical incoming material, storage capacity/filters and manual plus event-woken automatic factory-input handling.
Recipes for weapons, ammunition, construction material, support equipment and vehicles; actual inputs/earned work/output custody. R01 produces an intact unloaded rifle.
main_game.limit: Catalogued recipes are not all verified through the complete ordinary UI-to-frontline loop.

main_game.feature: Eight training course types with instructors/students, prerequisites, real duration, withdrawal, access control and current/completed course display.
main_game.limit: A Drone operator course is not proof of an implemented playable drone subsystem.

main_game.feature: Vehicle manufacture, crew/driver assignment, fuel and parking/loading; real rear-to-HQ dispatch, unloading and returning trucks. Manual and automatic supply intents, cancellation holds and outstanding-promise accounting.
HQ issue, forward ammunition deliveries/vehicle rack supply and troop boarding, transport and dismount.
main_game.limit: Controlled component deliveries have passed; ordinary repeated autonomous causal-loop acceptance is still pending.

main_game.feature: Farmland battlefield observation with pan/zoom and inspection; autonomous squads/vehicles, movement/orders, contacts, infantry and mounted combat, ammunition/reload, wounds/suppression/morale and care.
main_game.limit: Battlefield operations are autonomous; do not infer a full player tactical-command UI or exhaustive integration coverage.

main_game.feature: Physical objective contest/capture, ownership and resource income.

backend_and_review_scenarios.feature: Vehicle repair, recovery, towing and wreck handling.
